fact: Car 27 collided with Car 87 in turn 4
offence: Breach of Appendix L, Chapter IV, Article 2 d) of the FIA International Sporting Code.
reason: The Stewards reviewed video and in-car video evidence. Car 27 collided with the rear of Car 87 into turn 4. Even though this was a first lap (after a Restart) incident, the stewards have determined that no other cars contributed to the incident which was soley the fault of the driver of Car 27 hence no mitigating circumstances exist.
stewards: in accordance with Article 15 of the FIA International Sporting Code
are based solely on the relevant regulations
title: Infringement Car 27 Causing A Collision
to: The Team Manager, Audi Revolut F1 Team
